stories.title: When Dharma Shaped a Civilization
stories.description: A wide-shot cinematic retelling of Indian history, where landscapes lead the story and Lord Ram appears small within vast environments.

scenes.visual_prompt: Ultra-wide cinematic establishing shot. Character design: Lord Ram as described in classical Indian art — youthful male, tall lean build, blue-tinted skin, long dark hair tied in a traditional topknot, subtle tilak, wearing simple saffron dhoti and shawl, holding a wooden bow. Lord Ram appears small in frame, standing on a high stone terrace overlooking vast ancient Ayodhya. Grand palace rooftops, temple spires, flowing river, distant forests, soft morning mist. Camera performs a very slow forward dolly. Golden sunrise lighting, mythological realism, calm majestic tone.
scenes.negative_prompt: close-up, text, watermark, logo, modern objects
scenes.narration: In ancient India, leadership was not measured by power… but by dharma.

scenes.visual_prompt: Ultra-wide shot. Character design: Lord Ram as described in classical Indian art — youthful male, lean build, blue-tinted skin, long dark hair in topknot, subtle tilak, saffron attire, wooden bow. Lord Ram appears small in the distance, standing at the edge of a vast forest path. Far behind him, palace structures fade into morning haze. Tall ancient trees, flowing river, birds crossing the sky. Camera slowly pans sideways, emphasizing separation between palace and forest. Soft natural light, epic Indian landscape, mythological realism.
scenes.narration: When the moment came, Ram chose duty over the throne.

scenes.visual_prompt: Ultra-wide landscape shot. Character design: Lord Ram as described in classical Indian art — youthful male, lean build, blue-tinted skin, long dark hair tied back, subtle tilak, simple saffron attire, wooden bow. Lord Ram appears very small, walking calmly through a vast ancient forest valley. Mountains in the distance, clouds drifting, sunlight breaking through. Camera follows from very far behind with slow tracking motion. Serene timeless mood, mythological realism.
scenes.narration: He walked away from comfort… to protect truth and honor.

scenes.visual_prompt: Ultra-wide epic silhouette shot. Character design: Lord Ram as described in classical Indian art — youthful male, lean build, blue-tinted skin, long dark hair in topknot, subtle tilak, saffron dhoti and shawl, wooden bow. Lord Ram appears as a small silhouette on a hilltop overlooking vast rivers, forests, and distant lands. Camera slowly pulls back, increasing scale. Glowing sunset sky, warm divine light, atmospheric haze, legendary Indian historical tone.
scenes.narration: And that choice shaped a civilization… forever.
